title: Customers
description: Individual and corporate customers, drivers, consents and documents. Identity and contact data is shown masked.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view customers.
not_found: The customer was not found or you have no access.
empty_description: Add the first customer or import your İdes customer list.
empty_filtered_description: Change or clear the filters. When searching by identity number, type the full number.
create_description: Individual or corporate customer; the identity number is stored encrypted.
edit_description: Identity, contact, billing, tags and note.
detail_description: Customer record, drivers, marketing consents, documents and activity.
masked_hint: Masked value — use "Reveal" on the customer page to see it.
coming.rentals: Rental history arrives with reservations and contracts (M3).
coming.account: The account summary arrives with payments and invoices (M4).
form.section_identity_desc: TCKN / VKN are checksum-validated; a passport needs the nationality.
form.section_contact_desc: Phone and e-mail are masked in lists.
form.section_notes_desc: Tags for search and filters, an internal note.
form.keep_hint: Leave empty to keep the stored value.
form.identity_hint: The number is stored encrypted and shown masked in lists.
form.encryption_note: Identity and licence numbers are stored encrypted. Seeing them needs a separate permission and is recorded with a reason.
form.phone_hint: Turkish numbers may be written as 0532…
form.tags_hint: Separate with commas: VIP, Fleet, Blocked
validation.passport: A passport number has 5–20 letters or digits.
validation.identity_type: Choose an identity type that fits the customer type.
validation.nationality_passport: Select the nationality for a passport.
validation.tag_length: A tag has at most 40 characters.
validation.licence: A licence number has 4–32 letters or digits.
validation.licence_dates: The expiry cannot be before the issue date.
validation.licence_before_birth: A licence cannot be issued before the birth date.
quick_edit.title: Quick edit
reveal.title: Reveal sensitive data
reveal.description: Identity, licence and contact data is shown for a limited time.
reveal.audit_note: This is recorded with the reason in the customer's activity (KVKK).
reveal.reason_placeholder: E.g. preparing the rental contract, identity check
reveal.reason_short: The reason needs at least 3 characters.
anonymize.title: Anonymize the customer
anonymize.description: Data subject request: personal data is wiped, the record stays for references.
anonymize.warning: Names, identity, contact, billing, note and tags are wiped; contacts and drivers are removed, documents deleted, open consents withdrawn. This cannot be undone.
sensitive_export.title: Export with sensitive data
sensitive_export.description: The file contains identity numbers, phones and e-mails in clear.
sensitive_export.warning: This export is recorded. Share the file only with authorized people and delete it when done.
bulk.tag_hint: The tag applied to the selected customers.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.empty_description: Add people such as the fleet manager or accounting.
consents.help: Commercial message consents are separate records per channel; every grant and withdrawal is kept with its source and text version.
consents.dialog_description: Stored with the source and the accepted text version.
consents.text_version_hint: Version of the consent text the customer accepted.
consents.empty_description: Granted and withdrawn consents are listed here.
drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.help: For corporate customers the contract party, invoice addressee and actual driver are separate; the reservation picks each.
drivers.self_note: Name, identity, nationality and contact come from {{name}}. Enter the licence details.
drivers.dialog_description: The licence number is stored encrypted; age and licence years are computed for rental conditions.
drivers.empty_description: Add the people who will drive.
drivers.licence_country_hint: Anything but Türkiye is a foreign licence.
eligibility.title: Rental condition check
eligibility.not_eligible: The driver does not meet the conditions:
eligibility.reasons.licence_issue_date_m: The licence issue date is missing.
documents.title: Documents
documents.help: Identity and licence scans are kept in private storage; every download is recorded.
documents.help_no_download: Downloading documents needs the document download and reveal permissions.
documents.dialog_description: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP; at most 10 MB.
documents.empty_description: Add identity, licence or tax certificate scans.
documents.file_hint: The type is checked from the content; no storage URL reaches the browser.
activity.title: Activity
toast.download_failed: The file could not be downloaded.
